svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.

g.desc: Happy birthday Trap 🎂 Hope the best things for you in life and may your joy stay abundant in this day, and the many others that you will have to encounter 🤍 may you be blessed and thrive in whatever you put your heart into!! Happy birthday 🥳 enjoy
